select:
select old_val, new_val, field_name, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS created_time, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName
from jml_object_change_history a left join jml_staff cs on a.created_staff_id = cs.id
object_code = #{objectCode} and object_id = #{objectId}
order by a.update_time desc
